text: A Psalm of David. 1 Unto YHWH [is] the earth and its fullness, the world and those dwelling in it.
For He has founded it upon the seas, and upon the rivers He established it.
Who will ascend onto the hill of YHWH, or who will stand in His holy place?
The one clean of hands and pure of heart, who has not lifted up his soul to vanity, and has not sworn by deceit.
He will lift up a blessing from YHWH, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
This [is] the generation of those seeking Him, those seeking Your face, [O God] of Jacob. Selah
